The Young Women’s Preparatory Network (YWPN) scholars program scholarship is an achievement-based scholarship awarded to young women from a YWPN school that embody the mission and core values that founded our organization: Leadership, College Readiness, and Health/Wellness.
Additionally, these young women are recognized for their capacity to lead and serve, and their commitment to making a significant impact on their schools and communities.
